vocabulary.meaning_en: how good or wise it is to do something
vocabulary.example: This lesson is about modals of advisability.

vocabulary.meaning_en: wise; a good idea to do
vocabulary.example: It is advisable to book your ticket early.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an opinion about what someone should do
vocabulary.note_ar: اسم غير معدود؛ الفعل advise بحرف s
vocabulary.note_en: Uncountable noun; the verb is advise (with s).
vocabulary.example: Can I give you some advice?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the right or best thing to do (general advice)
vocabulary.example: You should brush your teeth before bed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: strong advice for a specific situation; if you don't, something bad will happen
vocabulary.meaning_ar: من الأفضل لك أن (وإلا ستحدث عاقبة)
vocabulary.note_ar: تُختصر غالبًا: you'd better، والنفي: had better not
vocabulary.note_en: Often shortened: you'd better. Negative: had better not.
vocabulary.example: You'd better hurry, or you'll miss the bus.

vocabulary.meaning_en: moving away from the normal or expected way
vocabulary.example: A sudden price change is a deviation from what we expect.
The result was below my expectation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a result, usually bad, of an action
an idea you give to someone to think about
true for most people or most cases
vocabulary.example: This is a general rule for all students.

vocabulary.meaning_en: about one particular person, thing or situation
vocabulary.example: I have a specific question about my visa.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give your work to a teacher or boss
vocabulary.example: Please hand in your essay on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to not pass a test or course
vocabulary.example: If you don't study, you might fail.

fine_lines.title: should vs had better
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان للنصيحة. should = الشيء الصحيح أو الأفضل، لقاعدة عامة تنطبق على أغلب الناس، ولا يوجد تهديد بعاقبة. had better = نصيحة لموقف محدد، وإن لم تفعل ستحدث عاقبة سيئة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both give advice. should = the right or best thing to do, a general rule for most people, no clear consequence. had better = advice for a specific situation; if you don't, something bad will happen.

examples.sentence: Drivers should not use their phones. (general rule)
You'd better slow down. There's a police car behind you! (specific, consequence)

fine_lines.title: had better: past form, present meaning
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلمة had في had better شكلها ماضٍ لكن المعنى حاضر أو مستقبل، وليست ماضيًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: In had better, "had" looks like the past, but the meaning is present or future, not past.

examples.sentence: We had a test yesterday. (real past)

expressions.example: You'd better take an umbrella. It's going to rain.

expressions.meaning_en: Strong advice not to do something.
expressions.example: You'd better not touch that. It's hot.
It's getting late. I'd better go.

expressions.meaning_en: What we expect (and it is different now).
expressions.example: This pen should be one dollar, not two!

expressions.meaning_en: It is a very good idea.
expressions.example: Practising every day is highly advisable.

grammar.title: Should: right/best thing and general rules
grammar.explanation_ar: should + المصدر نستخدمها: (1) لقول الشيء الصحيح أو الأفضل، (2) للقواعد العامة التي تنطبق على أغلب الناس (generally speaking). النفي: shouldn't.
grammar.explanation_en: should + base verb is used: (1) for the right or best thing to do, (2) for general rules that are true for most people (generally speaking). Negative: shouldn't.
examples: You should study hard if you want to be a good student.

grammar.title: Should: deviation from expectation
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم should أيضًا عندما يختلف الواقع عمّا توقعناه: القلم كان بدولار كل يوم، واليوم بدولار ونصف ← This pen should be a dollar.
grammar.explanation_en: We also use should when reality is different from what we expected: the pen was $1 every day, today it's $1.50 → This pen should be a dollar.
examples: The bus should be here by now. It's late.
This pen should be one dollar.

grammar.title: Had better: specific situation + consequence
grammar.explanation_ar: التركيب: الفاعل + had better (أو 'd better) + المصدر. للنفي: had better not + المصدر. نستخدمه لموقف محدد مع عاقبة واضحة.
grammar.explanation_en: Structure: subject + had better ('d better) + base verb. Negative: had better not + base verb. Use it for a specific situation with a clear consequence.
examples: You'd better hand in your essay, or the teacher will fail you.
We'd better buy it now while it's cheap.
You'd better not be late again.

grammar.title: Modal rule 1: base form after the modal
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد should و could و would و had better يأتي الفعل في صيغة المصدر: بدون s أو ed أو ing وبدون to.
grammar.explanation_en: After should, could, would and had better, the verb is in the base form: no -s, -ed, -ing, and no to.
examples: You should take a rest. (not: should takes / should to take)
You'd better call him. (not: had better to call)

questions.question: Which one shows a consequence in a specific situation?
questions.explanation_ar: had better لموقف محدد مع عاقبة.
questions.explanation_en: Had better is for a specific situation with a consequence.

questions.question: All students ___ respect their teachers. (general rule)
questions.explanation_en: A general rule for all students: should.

questions.question: You'd better ___ your essay, or you will fail.
questions.explanation_en: After had better, use the base form.

questions.question: What is the negative of "You'd better go"?
questions.explanation_en: Negative: had better not + base verb.

questions.question: The pen was $1 every day. Today it is $1.50. You say: "This pen ___ a dollar."
Is "had better" about the past?
choices: No, it is about now or the future.
questions.explanation_ar: شكلها ماضٍ لكن معناها حاضر أو مستقبل.
questions.explanation_en: It looks past, but the meaning is present or future.

questions.question: What does "deviation" mean?
choices: moving away from the normal way
questions.explanation_en: Deviation = moving away from the normal way.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: She should to call her mother.
